title: Testing the HSCT hypothesis in an IDS-related disease model

sentences.text: This is a hypothesis, not a finding; its weakest link is the claim that haematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT), used early for Krabbe disease, targets lysosomal enzyme deficiency.
Test whether HSCT improves a lysosomal enzyme deficiency readout in a non-patient model of IDS-related disease (Hunter syndrome).
Before starting, identify or build a suitable cell or animal model and establish an assay; this plan does not specify a ready-to-use model or protocol.
Seek the readout used to support HSCT in its known disease context before selecting the experimental setup.
IDS-related disease involves loss of enzyme activity and accumulation of glycosaminoglycans, including heparan sulfate and dermatan sulfate.
Choose an established readout of that deficiency and compare it with and without HSCT.
Use the same disease model without HSCT as the comparison, measuring the same readout in both conditions.
